spec.description: Four circumference points with perpendicular crossing chords. A coordinate-derived right-angle square marks their intersection. The lower-left angle is x°; a curved arrow identifies the right-hand 35° angle.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left circumference angle equals 35° because it stands on the same arc as the given angle. The triangle formed by the upper-left point, lower-left point and chord intersection then gives x=180°−90°−35°.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 35°, perpendicularity mark and unknown x° are visible; no solution labels are supplied.

answer.worked:
The angle at the upper-left point is $35^\circ$, since angles at the circumference standing on the same arc are equal.

Using the triangle formed by the upper-left point, lower-left point and chord intersection:
$$\begin{align*}x&=180^\circ-90^\circ-35^\circ\\x&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
